committee.online_extra_cost: five small Ridge matrix-vector predictions; preview/VLM cost unchanged

notes: Prompt margin and committee expected regret use no preview image and no target labels.
Gate type and requested coverage are selected jointly on the 200-prompt library-validation block.
Probed rows use real Qwen3.5-2B@320 features and pay both measured analytical evaluator FLOPs and Flux4B preview cost.
When the final action is F4B4, its preview image is reused rather than generated twice.
Coverage-zero and coverage-one candidates make no use of their nominal gate score, so duplicate gate-type entries are expected.
